photos.title: First Meeting
photos.memory: We shared cinnamon coffee at the little corner cafe. Neither of us remembers anyone sitting nearby.

anomalies.description: Roni looks faintly pale with wide unfocused eyes and a flat expression, while a dim shadow falls behind her shoulder.
anomalies.hint: Compare Roni's face, her wide staring eyes, and the booth backrest behind her shoulder.

photos.title: First Date
photos.memory: We stayed on the park bench until the water turned silver. The far bank was empty when we left.

anomalies.description: Roni looks pale and tired with heavy half-lidded eyes and a joyless frown, while a dark shadow creeps over her green poster and pools around her boots.
anomalies.hint: Compare Roni's pale face, the shadow across her green poster, and the dark stain under her boots.

photos.title: Sunflower Day
photos.memory: Kallita held one small sunflower for the walk home. All the flowers seemed to watch us pass.

anomalies.description: Roni looks gaunt and exhausted with dark-ringed eyes and crimson staining on her coat, while the sunflower behind her wilts and a dark shadow gathers around her boots.
anomalies.hint: Look at Roni's pale face, the crimson stain on her coat, the wilted sunflower behind her, and the shadow at her boots.

photos.title: Rainy Afternoon
photos.memory: Kallita held the umbrella while we hurried through the rain. We thought the puddles reflected only the two of us.

anomalies.description: Roni looks pale and exhausted beneath a darkened umbrella, with an unnatural shadow pooling around her boots.
anomalies.hint: Compare Roni's face and the puddle directly under her boots.

photos.title: Home Cooking
photos.memory: Our first soup filled the kitchen with warmth. We had set out only the dishes we needed.

anomalies.description: Roni looks hollow-eyed and exhausted, with dark reddish stains on her sleeve and the kitchen floorboards beneath her.
anomalies.hint: Inspect Roni's face, her coat cuff, and the floor tiles near her boots.

photos.title: City Night
photos.memory: The late shops lit our way home through the city. Kallita said the upstairs windows were all quiet.

anomalies.description: Roni's expression is empty and pale, and dark reddish stains mark the box in her paws and the sidewalk beneath her.
anomalies.hint: Check Roni's face, the pink box she holds, and the pavement below.

anomalies.description: The upper-right building window has gone dark, marked with a faint crimson smear.
anomalies.hint: Look inside the dark frame of the upper-right building window.

photos.title: Birthday
photos.memory: Roni laughed before the candles were blown out. We cannot remember inviting another guest.

anomalies.description: Roni appears visibly weaker and emotionally absent, with crimson blood stains soaking her sleeve, the birthday tablecloth, and the floor.
anomalies.hint: Examine Roni's face, the tablecloth in front of her, and the floor beneath the table.

anomalies.description: The left window has darkened into a cracked pane holding a distorted shadow.
anomalies.hint: Look closely at the darkened window behind the left side of the table.

photos.title: The Old House
photos.memory: We found the old house just as the afternoon faded. The key was cold and the rooms were supposed to be empty.

anomalies.description: Roni is visibly hunched and pale with frightened eyes, while blood stains spread down her coat and onto the step.
anomalies.hint: Look closely at Roni's slumped head, coat front, and feet.

anomalies.description: The right window has deteriorated into dark glass marked with crimson smears and a faint reflection.
anomalies.hint: Inspect the window on the right side of the house.

photos.title: Picnic
photos.memory: We spread the checked blanket beneath the old tree. The sunlight felt warm even where the shadows disagreed.

anomalies.description: Roni is heavily slumped and gaunt with a distorted, frightened face, while dark blood stains her coat, the blanket, and the withered grass.
anomalies.hint: Look closely at Roni's distorted face, slumped posture, and the blanket beneath her.

anomalies.description: A dark unnatural shadow stretches past the picnic blanket toward crimson-stained grass.
anomalies.hint: Inspect the shadow stretching off the right edge of the picnic blanket.

photos.title: Anniversary
photos.memory: We brought home flowers to mark another year together. The mirror kept more of the evening than we remember.

anomalies.description: Roni is hunched and almost unrecognizable with sunken eyes and distorted features, soaked in dark crimson stains.
anomalies.hint: Examine Roni's collapsed face, coat, and the floorboards beneath her.

anomalies.description: Inside the cracked oval mirror, Roni's reflection has vanished into a dark crimson smear beside Kallita.
anomalies.hint: Look inside the cracked oval mirror on the right.

photos.title: Family Portrait
photos.memory: We dressed carefully for a portrait of our little family. Nobody else was meant to be in the room.

anomalies.description: Roni can barely stay upright, her head slumped low with lifeless sunken eyes and heavy crimson staining across her coat, sofa, and floor.
anomalies.hint: Look at Roni's slumped head, coat, the sofa beside her, and the floor.

anomalies.description: Inside the small framed portrait on the right, Roni's figure has vanished beneath dark crimson scratches.
anomalies.hint: Inspect the small framed portrait on the right wall.

photos.title: The Revelation
photos.memory: The photographs were never showing someone else. They were showing what was happening to Roni all along.

anomalies.description: Roni is slumped almost lifeless at the table with sunken eyes and heavy bloodstains across her coat, the tablecloth, and the floorboards.
anomalies.hint: Look closely at Roni's collapsed posture, pale face, and the blood soaking the tablecloth and floor.

anomalies.description: Through the open doorway lies a dim room—and a motionless figure sitting in a chair, slumped forward with her head resting on a bloodstained desk.
anomalies.hint: Look closely inside the dark open doorway on the right.
